harvestsTotal.description: §3.13: every ACTIVE harvest on the node, whether or not this answer served it. 732 measured on one node at one pin, a 266 KB answer with vitals.

harvestsEligible.description: §3.13 (0.5.2): `--eligible-only` ONLY, absent without the flag. Rows that passed the filter, out of harvestsTotal — which keeps reporting the WHOLE node.

harvestsServed.description: §3.13: how many rows this answer carries. Below the total when the cap fired; --full lifts it.

room.description: §3.12 (enrich): roomIndex resolved. On roster, {index, name} only — the compact answer stays compact.

cooldownUntil.description: §3.8 (0.5.2): the RAW on-chain cooldown end time, in CHAIN SECONDS — the value cooldownSec is projected from. 0 means the mirror holds no NextTime for this kami (it has never acted, or the component has not synced yet); treat 0 as unknown, never as 'ready'.

level.description: §3.13: the occupant's level. This is the surface a liquidation decision is made on, and it served health without ever naming how strong the thing holding it was.

xpRequired.description: §3.13: what the occupant's next level costs.

levelUpBlockedBy.description: §3.13: present exactly when levelUpReady is false.

affinities.description: §3.16 (0.5.1): [body, hand] affinities, `--stats` only. The reference client's own pair and its own defaulting ('NORMAL' where the trait carries none). The liquidation calcs turn on exactly this pair, so a reader previewing a liquidation could not check the preview's inputs without it.

reason.description: §3.13 (0.5.0): present exactly when `eligible` is false. Upstream's own precedence, from the reference client's LiquidateButton tooltip: starving first, then cooldown, then the threshold comparison — with the degenerate no-threshold-at-all case called out separately, exactly as that tooltip does. The client's fifth branch ("your kamis aren't on this node") has no analogue here: the attacker is a general argument on this surface, never an own-only path (§3.6).

margin.description: §3.13 (0.5.2): threshold minus the occupant's projected hp. May be negative. The projection error is NOT bounded (SPEC §3.13), so a caller wanting certainty requires a margin rather than trusting `eligible`.

cooldownUntil.description: §3.8 (0.5.2): the RAW on-chain cooldown end time, in CHAIN SECONDS — the value cooldownSec is projected from. 0 means the mirror holds no NextTime for this kami (it has never acted, or the component has not synced yet); treat 0 as unknown, never as 'ready'.

id.description: `--full` only from 0.5.0 on node harvest rows (§3.13).

name.description: `--full` only from 0.5.0 on node harvest rows (§3.13).
`--full` only from 0.5.0 on node harvest rows (§3.13).

RoomRef.description: §3.12 (enrich): a room index resolved to its registry name and description. Present only when the daemon runs with enrich=true. An index the mirror has no room for keeps the index and answers with empty strings.

Stat.description: §3.16 (0.5.1): one stat as the mirror decodes it. base/shift/boost/sync are the four parts packed into the stat's uint256 on chain; `total` is the reference client's own effective value, (1 + boost/1e3) x (base + shift), after skills and equipment. Named `total` and not `current` because this answer already carries hp.current (live drained/regenerated health) beside hp.total. There is no `rate` field: Stat.rate is written only for health, so it would be a structural zero on the other three (§3.14). `shift` is bonus-inclusive; the chain's stored component value is not — G2.d records both.

Stats.description: §3.16 (0.5.1): the kami sheet's stat block, `--stats` only — absent from every answer that did not pass the flag. Exactly the four stats the chain's own GetterSystem.getKamiByIndex tuple carries, which is what makes the block gate-able against chain (G2.d); `slots` and `stamina` exist in the mirror but not in that tuple, so they are not served here.
